Navigation index for coding agents. This is not a capability claim. Trust `docs/agents/capabilities.json` and the tests.

- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md) — no `FILEVORA_DATABASE_URL` is lite mode; a URL selects stored mode. Schemes: `postgres://`, `postgresql://`, `mysql://`, `mariadb://`, `sqlite://` or a file path. Migrate creates only `filevora_assets` and `filevora_asset_versions`.
